name: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition
description: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition is a singleplayer isometric role-playing game, an enhanced edition of 1999's Planescape: Torment.

eax.problem: This is the Enhanced Edition, not the original Planescape: Torment, and it has no EAX.

notes: If you still own the original 1999 Planescape: Torment, which GOG stopped selling on its own in April 2017, that one still supports EAX.
